CustomField.description: Q-6: Marks this as the primary quote for the opportunity. Only one quote per opportunity can be primary. Required before accepting a quote (SOF gate). Auto-clears on other quotes when a new primary is selected.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to designate this as the primary quote for this deal. Only one quote per opportunity can be the primary. This is required before the SOF can be accepted.
CustomField.label: Primary Quote
